thread:
ana: Heads-up: hit a reproducible onboarding hang in sampleapp when token rotate happens mid-paginate. SDK drops effective concurrency and the paginator stalls for ~5-7s. Not seeing upstream 429s, so feels like a client-side control-loop bug. Anyone seen this variant?

 tom: which paginator? adaptive prefetch or fixed-window?

 ana: adaptive prefetch (newer lib). repro: 7 parallel clients, pageSize=32, force refresh ~4-6s in. After refresh each client drops from ~6->1 concurrent fetch slots and outstanding fetches queue. UI freeze for a handful of seconds.

 rachel: yikes. was there an auth error or just refresh success?

 ana: refresh returns 200. logs:

 ```
 [2026-03-26T08:12:03Z] fetch.page(c=5,p=10) -> 200 lat=85ms
 [2026-03-26T08:12:08Z] auth.refresh(c=5) -> 200
 [2026-03-26T08:12:08Z] client.concurrency.adjust(c=5) old=6 new=1 reason=auth_event
 [2026-03-26T08:12:08Z] prefetch.enqueue(c=2,p=11) queued=7 wait=4.5s
 ```

 tom: sounds like a sharp clamp on any auth event. That interacts badly with the prefetch "pump" which tries to refill N outstanding requests and ends up queueing them. Control-loop oscillation.

 ana: exactly. The pump sees the buffer drop and aggressively issues requests, but the clamp prevents them from dispatching so they pile up.

 rachel: two things we could try (lessons learned): (A) introduce a short grace window after a successful refresh where we give the client a small credit (soft tokens) to keep pipeline moving. (B) make prefetch target a function of current concurrency slot count (so it won't try to fill to the old level while window is small).

 tom: +1. For (A) propose: on auth success grant min(2, ceil(old*0.2)) soft credits for X ms (e.g., 250ms) that allow dispatching without shrinking below 1. That prevents immediate stalls but still defends against real error cascades.

 ana: alternative phrasing: "grace window ms" config. Default 300ms. If new auth error occurs during grace, revoke credits.

 rachel: For (B) prefetchTarget = max(1, floor(currentSlots * prefetchFactor)) where prefetchFactor default 1.1. That keeps pump proportional. Also add a safety that pump will not issue more than `prefetchCushion` above currentSlots (prefetchCushion default 3).

 fred: nice. Also worth adding a heuristic: if auth refresh returned success and observed downstream error rate <4% in the next N requests, then gradually restore to previous window over M seconds instead of hard clamp.

 ci-bot: Created ticket DEVPACK-7264 "sdk: add auth-grace credits + proportional prefetch to avoid pagination stalls" and attached logs from ana.

 ana: I'll hack a deterministic integration that manipulates token TTL and clock and asserts mean queue-time <2.5s across 7 clients. If that passes I'll open a test-only feature flag for CI.

 tom: PR idea: add SDK_AUTH_GRACE_MS and SDK_PREFETCH_CUSHION env vars and a small unit test around pump behavior. Keep defaults conservative.

 rachel: devdocs note: onboarding guide should call out token rotation interactions and suggest using a refresh margin (e.g., rotate >30s after heavy scan start) during load tests. We'll add a short blurb.

 ana: plan: I'll prototype change + test, post draft PR. tom, can you review the concurrency code and help pick defaults?

 tom: yep. After PR lands run sampleapp-load (https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp-load) and watch the per-client dispatch wait histogram + prefetch fill metrics. If we still spike we can tweak grace_ms and cushion.

 ana: thanks everyone. I'll post PR + CI link here when ready. :rocket:
